about: Second judge constants set on quran-asr-small and the official text only, in text_harness.mjs, with no engine output, apart from mut below. Frozen on dev before the test split was read.

mut.meaning: a mutashabih alternative must beat the expected word by this
mut.source: h1_joint.mjs on dev: the last margin before false alarms on correct words jump. The table has no engine output, but the end-to-end dev sweep had been seen when this was fixed, and the table alone supports 3 or 4
mut.license: NPL-1.2 because of that: the app reads it from services/recitation/followerConstants.npl.json

altFit.meaning: and must itself score at least minus this

fit.meaning: the expected word fits when it scores at least minus this
fit.source: h1_report.mjs on dev: changed words scoring above this are about 1.5%

absent.meaning: no word here must beat the expected word by this, and score at least -altFit

rightWords.meaning: words of right context when scoring a word; 1 for the no-word score

cutSeconds.meaning: slice starts this long before the ayah's first word
cutSeconds.source: text harness grid on dev; 1 s scored the same

tailSeconds.meaning: slice ends this long after the ayah's end
tailSeconds.source: text harness grid on dev; 1 s scored the same

firstWithinFrames.meaning: an ayah's first word must begin within this many 40 ms frames of the slice's start
firstWithinFrames.source: design: how far the slice's start can miss the ayah's

nearWords.meaning: words within edit distance 2 are not alternatives
nearWords.source: dev and test: no exact catch gained, one more false mark
